_about: The quality bar and the engine's tunable numbers. Every value cites its evidence in docs/clips/RESEARCH.md (section in brackets). Change values only with new evidence, and say so in docs/CLIPS_ENGINE.md history.

duration_s._why: [3.2] quso.ai 108k Shorts: median views peak at 11-20 s and fall after 30 s; [3.1] the 14 clip-style references we measured run 21-161 s (median 61 s). Stream moments need a setup, so 20-45 s is the target and 58 s the hard cap.

hook._why: [3.1] 14 references: text on screen by 0.5 s at the latest (median 0.0 s), speech by 0.92 s (median 0.05 s).

captions._why: [3.1] 14 references: captions centred at 0.18-0.85 of the height (median 0.575; the Kick clips 0.49-0.50), text about 3% of the frame tall, 1-3 words on screen, UPPER CASE, yellow the commonest highlight colour.

loudness._why: [3.1] 14 references median -14.5 LUFS; YouTube normalises playback near -14 LUFS.

pace._why: [3.1] references median 2.1 cuts per 10 s (0 to 5.1): our edit cuts + framing cuts must reach the median; a stream is one camera, so pace comes from cutting dead air and changing the framing.

ui_safe._why: [3.4] the Shorts player covers the bottom (title, channel, music; keep 25-35% clear), the top ~15% and a column of buttons on the right (10-15%): Reap safe-zone guide, Sep 2026 (an editorial recommendation; YouTube publishes no organic template).

signal_weights._why: [4.2] priors: chat volume, message length and similarity predict highlights (Lightor, ICDE 2020); viewer clips are direct human votes. To be refit on the winners/baseline dataset once it exists [6].

hook.what: Would a stranger stop in the first second? Tension, a question, a number, an extreme.

moment.what: A clear setup and a payoff (fail, win, reveal, punchline) that a viewer with no context understands.

pacing.what: No dead air, a cut or zoom change every 2-5 s, the payoff not buried.

layout.what: The face and the action are both visible and big enough on a phone.

captions.what: Readable word-by-word captions in the measured style, in sync, outside the UI zones.

sound.what: Loudness near -14 LUFS, voice clear, no clipping.

ending.what: Ends on the punchline or loops; no trailing filler.

trend_fit.what: Fits what clip channels post now (stream reactions, fails, confessions).
